description: This file contains validation rules for form inputs in the OrangeHRM system, including functions for required fields, character length constraints, range validation, email and phone formats, and special character restrictions.

methods.name: required
methods.description: Validates that a value is present, handling string, number, array, and object types.

methods.name: shouldNotExceedCharLength
methods.description: Returns a validation function that checks if a string exceeds a specified maximum length.

methods.name: validRange
methods.description: Returns a validation function that checks if a numeric string falls within a specified range and length.

methods.name: digitsOnly
methods.description: Validates that a string contains only digits.

methods.name: validEmailFormat
methods.description: Validates that a string matches a standard email format.

methods.name: validPhoneNumberFormat
methods.description: Validates that a string contains only allowed phone number characters.

methods.name: shouldNotLessThanCharLength
methods.description: Returns a validation function that checks if a string has at least a specified minimum length.

methods.name: shouldNotContainSpecialChars
methods.description: Returns a validation function that checks if a string contains only alphanumeric characters and underscores.
